name: Back Testing Methodology 1
definition: Specifies the characteristics of a backtesting methodology used to test the performance of a risk model.

RiskModelType.name: Risk Model Type
RiskModelType.definition: Specifies the core model type, excluding any modifications for pro-cyclicality.

ModelConfidenceLevel.name: Model Confidence Level
ModelConfidenceLevel.definition: Specifies the confidence interval used on a daily basis to assess the performance of the model.

VariationMarginCleanIndicator.name: Variation Margin Clean Indicator
VariationMarginCleanIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the CCP model calculates mark-to-market changes on fixed portfolios when backtesting.
